findings.claim_text: davis7 reported 8/10 (80%) for Ox Alpha on a 10-task DeepSWE subset on August 21, 2026, saying it 'was a near miss on the x's so actually over 80%'; Sol scored 52% and Fable 65% on the same tasks.
findings.contradicting_quote: Actual DeepSWE run on the ox alpha mystery model is done. Ended at ~63% NOT the 80% my first subset test got

findings.claim_text: winkey_h reported Ox Alpha reached around 63% at 47K average output tokens on a DeepSWE subset, describing the result as pareto optimal amongst open models and just shy of Grok 4.6 among closed models.

Forensic analysis assigns roughly 90% confidence to Ox Alpha being a Zhipu next-generation multimodal GLM checkpoint such as a GLM-5.3 flash or GLM-5V variant, based on tokenizer, video-encoder, audio and speed fingerprints.
findings.contradicting_quote: one DeepMind researcher suggested Ox Alpha could be an unannounced Gemini Pro successor
